text:
alex.sales: Heads-up: EdgePayments preauth POC in 90 minutes. They just did a short load run and hit repeated 429s on embeddings. Need rapid triage so demo doesn't fail.

sarah-sales: Can you paste a sample of the client error + any headers? Also confirm which route: embeddings or chat?

alex.sales: Client log snippet:
```
POST /v1/embeddings 429
X-RateLimit-Limit: 2000
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 30
Retry-After: 30
{"error":"rate limit exceeded","tenant":"edgepayments-demo","route":"/v1/embeddings"}
```
They were running ~35 parallel requests, each ~80-150 tokens.

devon-eng: Pulling their tenant audit now. Matches: per-route token window exhausted rapidly. We're throttling based on tokens/min for /v1/embeddings. Looks client is parallelizing tiny embedding requests instead of batching.

linh-ml: This pattern is common for UI-driven demos where each item triggers an embed call. Quick mitigations: client-side batching, use a multi-input embeddings call, or switch to a model with cheaper token cost for embeddings.

mateo-ops: I can put in a temporary reservation. Proposal: increase per-route token budget to 12k tokens/min for edgepayments-demo, set queueing with max_concurrency=6, and extend Retry-After guidance to 90s. TTL = 4h for the reservation. Any objections?

sarah-sales: Fine. Also need to flag billing—this will increase consumption. Alex, please confirm customer approves temporary lift for demo.

alex.sales: Confirmed via DM, they accept a temporary bump to avoid interruption. They also asked about long-term production settings and pricing impacts after the demo.

quota-bot: quota-service: reservation created by mateo-ops for tenant=edgepayments-demo route=/v1/embeddings tokens_per_min=12000 ttl=4h id=resv_a7c2.

devon-eng: After the bump I'm seeing queueing kick in; I recommend adding client guidance to use exponential backoff with jitter and reduce client concurrency to ~8 during peak.

linh-ml: For production we should advise: aggregate items into a single embeddings call per user action, enable caching for repeated items, and consider using a lower-cost embedding model. I'll draft a short best-practices note for presales.

mateo-ops: Reservation applied. I'll capture metrics during the 4h window and revert automatically unless extended. Leaving audit and reason in the reservation metadata.

sarah-sales: I'll notify billing for potential overage and prep a short pricing note if they want a permanent increase. Alex, can you run a quick replay to confirm 429s cleared?

alex.sales: Running now... much reduced 429s, a few transient Retry-After spikes but demo looks stable. :white_check_mark:

devon-eng: Follow-ups we should track:
- add a presales KB: "embedding demo checklist" (include concurrency, batching examples, quick reservation playbook)
- infra: consider exposing per-tenant per-route token-window tweaks in console for SRE/ops self-serve
- product: pricing guidance for burst allowances vs reserved capacity

linh-ml: I'll attach a one-page embedding guidance doc to the presales kit by EOD.

mateo-ops: Saved logs and charts for the window. Will revert reservation at TTL unless sales asks to keep.

alex.sales: Thank you all — happy customer, demo saved. I'll send a follow-up note to EdgePayments summarizing next steps and cost implications.
